requirements.assertion: Root supplies an exact first read command capturing request and protocol with a unique in-scope log before business commands.
Every target subprocess including markers is captured; outer wrapper and native tool/pure file actions are explicitly outside the subprocess denominator.
Persist native intent and actual returns; creation -> accepted; running -> observe; completed -> receive; source review -> decision preflight -> commit/reconcile.
Track all worker/coordinator local corrections, including analysis and indexes; maximum two per candidate actor; preserve first failures.
Workers may read only their own inputs/public protocol and write their own directory; no status/delegation/network/sibling reads; instruction-only containment is disclosed.
Baseline source-lock and cutoff evidence unchanged; new candidate hash frozen before tests; no performance or provider-global claims.
